detail: This session (trigger trig_01MqCdfEMT7g5qDvxBAUkfUB, hourly-signal-check) began its own run and, during section 1 reconciliation, found BEN and ZION stop orders in cancelled state with no matching broker position, despite this session never having called cancel_equity_order or place_equity_order. Investigation of data/logs/2026-08-13.jsonl and the bot-state git history showed a second, independent execution of the same hourly-signal-check cycle completed concurrently (signal_check events at 17:06:44Z, exits filled 17:07:09-17:07:20Z, trade_closed 17:07:50Z, cycle_summary and bot-state push completed 17:08:24Z) before this session reached its own exit-evaluation step. That concurrent cycle appears to have executed correctly (stops cancelled before market sells, trades recorded, state pushed, entries correctly skipped on market_regime_filter_trend_not_intact). This session re-pulled bot-state, confirmed the resulting positions.json (11 open, BEN/ZION removed) and last_cycle_at.json are consistent with that concurrent run, and stood down from re-running reconciliation/circuit-breaker/exits/entries itself for this hour to avoid placing duplicate live orders. Recommend the user check for duplicate/overlapping firings of trig_01MqCdfEMT7g5qDvxBAUkfUB (hourly-signal-check) -- only one last_fired_at (17:06:30Z) is recorded for that trigger despite two concurrent executions.
